title: Coordinate formula for scale-add
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number, let $u\in\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $p,c\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^\ell$. For every coordinate $i<\ell$, the $i$th coordinate of the scale-add of $p$ by $u$ to $c$ is $c_i+u p_i$.
